mergedParams.userDescription: Glitchy artifacts and data corruption. internal effects for text, video, images

prompts.prompt: Create an internal effect preset called 'digital-corruption-flicker' that simulates data corruption through rapid opacity and color channel manipulation. The effect should create a stuttering, malfunctioning appearance by animating opacity with irregular keyframes (like 1, 0.2, 0.9, 0, 1 at uneven intervals), combined with RGB channel shifts using CSS filters. Include parameters for 'glitchIntensity' (0-1), 'duration' (ms), and 'colorShift' (boolean). The effect should use spring easing for abrupt, mechanical movements. Design it to work on any component type (text, video, or image) via targetIds.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic (AnimationRange[]). Properties: opacity (irregular keyframes at prog: 0, 0.15, 0.3, 0.45, 0.6, 0.75, 0.85, 1), filter for hue-rotate and saturate. Effect structure: { type: 'generic', mode: 'provider', targetIds, start: 0, duration: params.duration || 500, ranges: [...] }. Params schema: z.object({ glitchIntensity: z.number().min(0).max(1), duration: z.number(), colorShift: z.boolean(), targetIds: z.array(z.string()) }). PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects' }. Return: { effects: [effectData] }

prompts.prompt: Build a 'datamosh-displacement' internal effect that creates pixel-sorting artifacts through transform manipulation and blur effects. Animate translateX and translateY with jagged, stepped progressions (creating a 'broken transmission' look), while simultaneously applying dynamic blur that pulses between 0 and 8px. Add skewX animations that create horizontal tearing effects. Parameters should include 'displacementRange' (pixels), 'tearIntensity' (0-1), and 'blurAmount' (0-10). Use linear easing to maintain the harsh, digital aesthetic.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic (AnimationRange[]). Properties: translateX (stepped values: -20, 15, -8, 25, 0), translateY (random offsets), skewX (-5deg to 5deg), blur (0-8px pulses). Effect structure: { type: 'generic', mode: 'provider', targetIds, start: params.delay || 0, duration: params.duration || 800, easing: 'linear', ranges: [...] }. Params: z.object({ displacementRange: z.number(), tearIntensity: z.number(), blurAmount: z.number(), duration: z.number(), targetIds: z.array(z.string()) }). Return format: { effects: [{ ...effectData }] }

prompts.prompt: Design an 'audio-glitch-reactive' waveform effect that triggers corruption artifacts based on audio peaks. When bass frequencies spike above threshold, apply rapid scale distortions (0.95 to 1.1) combined with chromatic aberration via red/cyan color splits. Use the waveform data to modulate the intensity of digital noise patterns. Include 'sensitivity' (0-1), 'threshold' (0-1), and 'aberrationStrength' parameters. The effect should feel like the visual is breaking apart when the beat hits.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Waveform (audio-reactive). Configuration: { type: 'scale', audioProperty: 'bass', sensitivity: params.sensitivity || 0.8, threshold: params.threshold || 0.6 }. Additional filter effects for chromatic aberration using CSS filter drop-shadow. Effect structure: { type: 'waveform', mode: 'provider', targetIds, start: 0, duration: params.duration || 2000, props: { scale: { min: 0.95, max: 1.1 }, filter: 'drop-shadow(2px 0 red) drop-shadow(-2px 0 cyan)' } }. PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects', dependencies: { presets: [] } }

prompts.prompt: Create a 'scan-line-interference' effect that simulates CRT monitor interference patterns. Animate a combination of horizontal lines moving vertically (using repeating linear gradients in background-image), opacity flickering (0.8-1.0), and subtle brightness oscillation. Add parameters for 'lineSpeed' (pixels/second), 'lineOpacity' (0-1), and 'interferenceColor' (hex). The effect should layer multiple scan patterns at different speeds for complexity.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Combined (multiple generic effects). Properties: backgroundImage (linear-gradient animations), opacity (0.8-1.0 flicker), brightness (95%-105%). Multiple effect objects with different timing offsets. Structure: { effects: [scanEffect1, scanEffect2, brightnessEffect] }. Each effect: { type: 'generic', mode: 'provider', targetIds, ranges: [...] }. Params: z.object({ lineSpeed: z.number(), lineOpacity: z.number(), interferenceColor: z.string(), targetIds: z.array(z.string()) }). Return: { effects: [...arrayOfEffects] }

prompts.prompt: Build a 'binary-scramble-text' effect specifically for text elements that simulates data corruption at the character level. Animate letter-spacing to create expanding/contracting text (0-5px), while applying random text-shadow glitches (multiple shadows in red/green/blue). Include rapid fontSize micro-adjustments (98%-102%) to create instability. Parameters: 'scrambleIntensity', 'shadowCount' (1-5), 'colorPalette' (array of hex colors). Use ease-in-out for organic corruption flow.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic (text-specific properties). Properties: letterSpacing (0-5px animation), fontSize (98%-102% micro-adjustments), textShadow (multiple shadow values). AnimationRange: [{ key: 'letterSpacing', val: '0px', prog: 0 }, { key: 'letterSpacing', val: '3px', prog: 0.3 }, ...]. Effect: { type: 'generic', mode: 'provider', targetIds, start: 0, duration: params.duration || 600, easing: 'ease-in-out', ranges: [...] }. Text-specific targeting ensures only TextAtom components are affected.

prompts.prompt: Design a 'compression-artifact' effect that mimics low-quality video compression artifacts. Create blocky, pixelated distortions using a combination of scale snapping (rounds to nearest 0.05), contrast manipulation (50%-150%), and saturation drops (0%-100%). Add 'blockSize' parameter to control pixelation granularity, 'qualityDegradation' (0-1), and 'colorBanding' (boolean). The effect should create distinct 'macro blocks' typical of heavy compression.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic with filter combinations. Properties: scale (snapped values: 1.0, 1.05, 0.95), filter combining contrast() saturate() and custom blur. AnimationRange for each property with stepped progressions. Effect: { type: 'generic', mode: 'provider', targetIds, duration: params.duration || 1000, ranges: [scaleRanges, filterRanges] }. Params: z.object({ blockSize: z.number(), qualityDegradation: z.number(), colorBanding: z.boolean() }). Uses CSS filter functions for degradation effects.

prompts.prompt: Create a 'frequency-band-distortion' waveform effect that maps different audio frequencies to different corruption types. Low frequencies trigger horizontal displacement, mids cause rotation glitches, and highs create color inversions. Include 'frequencyMapping' object parameter to customize which frequencies affect which properties. The effect should create a synaesthetic visualization where each frequency band has its own corruption signature.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Multiple Waveform effects. Three separate waveform configurations: bass→translate, mid→rotate, treble→filter. Structure: { effects: [bassEffect, midEffect, trebleEffect] }. Each: { type: 'waveform', mode: 'provider', targetIds, props: { [property]: { min, max } } }. Params: z.object({ frequencyMapping: z.object({ bass: z.enum(['translate', 'scale', 'blur']), mid: z.enum(['rotate', 'skew']), treble: z.enum(['invert', 'hue'] }) }). Returns array of coordinated waveform effects.

prompts.prompt: Build a 'temporal-shift-glitch' effect that creates time displacement artifacts by animating elements as if frames are dropping or duplicating. Use translateZ with perspective to create depth-based distortion, combined with rapid opacity strobing (creating 'ghost frames'). Add rotation on Z-axis for spatial confusion. Parameters: 'frameDropRate' (0-1), 'temporalOffset' (ms), 'depthDistortion' (pixels). Use spring easing for jarring temporal jumps.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic with 3D transforms. Properties: translateZ (-50px to 50px), perspective (800px parent), rotateZ (-15deg to 15deg), opacity (strobing 0-1). Effect: { type: 'generic', mode: 'provider', targetIds, duration: params.duration || 750, easing: 'spring', ranges: [perspectiveRanges, rotateRanges, opacityRanges] }. Requires transform-style: preserve-3d on parent. Params: z.object({ frameDropRate: z.number(), temporalOffset: z.number(), depthDistortion: z.number() }).

prompts.prompt: Design a 'hexadecimal-overflow' effect that simulates memory overflow through color channel manipulation. Animate backgroundColor using hex values that 'overflow' (rapidly cycling through color space), combined with box-shadow creating multiple offset copies (data duplication). Include 'overflowSpeed' (color changes/second), 'duplicateCount' (1-10 shadows), and 'channelMask' (which RGB channels to affect). Create a hypnotic, corrupted rainbow effect.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic with color focus. Properties: backgroundColor (rapid hex transitions), boxShadow (multiple offsets with varying colors). AnimationRange with 8+ color keyframes. Effect: { type: 'generic', mode: 'provider', targetIds, duration: params.duration || 1200, ranges: [colorRanges, shadowRanges] }. Color generation algorithm based on channelMask parameter. Params: z.object({ overflowSpeed: z.number(), duplicateCount: z.number().min(1).max(10), channelMask: z.object({ r: z.boolean(), g: z.boolean(), b: z.boolean() }) }).

prompts.prompt: Create a 'signal-decay-dissolution' effect that simulates digital signal degradation over time. Start with subtle jitter (small translate variations), progressively add noise (grain filter), increase blur gradually (0-20px), and finally fragment with scale distortions. Include 'decayRate' (exponential/linear), 'finalState' (dissolved/frozen/black), and 'noiseIntensity'. The effect should feel like watching a digital transmission slowly fail.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic with progressive degradation. Properties: translate (increasing amplitude over time), blur (exponential growth 0-20px), scale (1.0 degrading to 0.8 or 1.2), filter for noise/grain. Non-linear progression values to simulate decay curve. Effect: { type: 'generic', mode: 'provider', targetIds, duration: params.duration || 3000, ranges: [...] }. Progressive keyframes with exponential prog values (0, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9, 0.95, 1). Params: z.object({ decayRate: z.enum(['exponential', 'linear']), finalState: z.enum(['dissolved', 'frozen', 'black']), noiseIntensity: z.number() }).
